study: mr-boxington PR/revision reviewer study: 47 PRs, 95 revisions per pass, 3 passes

grok.projection_method: For each Grok pass, calibrate its confirmed-material yield on PRs with every planned revision observed against the mean confirmed yield of Terra/high, DSF, Sol/high and Haiku (3passes each). Apply that ratio to the reference yield on missing/incomplete PRs; preserve any Grok material findings already observed there as a floor. Average the3pass projections. Four single-reference projections and uniform-PR expansion give sensitivity across assumptions, not a confidence interval.
grok.projection_assumptions: Grok/reference relative defect yield transfers from completed to missing PRs. Quota truncation follows PR order, so missingness is not random; no procedure here identifies unknown Grok-specific defects or grader uncertainty. Known observed partial findings never disappear.

single_review_estimate.yield_method: Quota-truncated Grok workflow projection multiplied by Terra/high initial/workflow retention (88/145); assumes both missing-cohort transfer and the same initial/workflow retention for Grok.
single_review_estimate.coverage: 253/285 revision reviews; 41 observed initial heads/pass; yield projected to 47 PRs
single_review_estimate.cost_note: Provider-reported API equivalent: observed first-pass mean across 41 initial heads; source monthly 73-event scenario divided by 73.

haiku.yield_method: Workflow material-root mean multiplied by Terra/high initial/workflow retention; assumes same retention for this model
